items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: And George Wallington and Annie came together, so George quit too.

ctx.x: Annie Ross made the trip over. But it didn't last long because people in Europe...she got horrible write-ups, so badly that she had to cancel out. We never, I never understood it but the write-ups were so bad for Annie Ross. And George Wallington and Annie came together, so George quit too. They just left, and both came back to the States.

But I think what happened about Annie Ross, originally something had happened in the past and they wasn't ready to accept Annie Ross. And they didn't want...couldn't accept Annie in the context of Lionel Hampton, some kind of way. They just wanted Hamp, or something.
